original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 17 memory slot's topology, DIMM identity, capability and configured operating fields against the approved memory recipe and across reboot.
original_method: Capture every Type 17 record with handle and locators, link to Type 16, preserve empty-slot sentinels and protected identifiers, normalize size/speed/voltage units, reboot under approval/recovery, then repeat and diff per slot.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the slot/DIMM recipe, unit/sentinel and negotiated-speed/voltage policies, approves restricted evidence and reboot/recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not suppress errors or bypass host authentication
Do not conflate rated and configured values
Do not reseat/replace DIMMs or change memory settings
agent_execution_scope: Map by handle plus device/bank locator
Compare capability and configured fields separately
Publish redacted summary without final verdict
engineer_actions: Supply slot recipe and normalization/tolerance policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 17` is correct, but the heading grep cannot collect 22 fields or multiple/empty slots; unsafe SSH and suppressed errors make evidence invalid.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture all Type 17 and related Type 16 records before and after an approved reboot, map each slot, apply explicit sentinel/unit/dynamic policies and protect identifiers.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All 22 named fields, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a slot-keyed inventory joining Type 17 to Type 16, with raw and canonical units, explicit empty-slot state, protected identity fields and separate rated/configured values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete topology, privacy and negotiated-state semantics rather than a header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing/swapped DIMMs, wrong widths/types/capacity, array-link errors, training-speed changes and voltage-policy drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware can reorder handles; locators and approved topology must anchor matching, with ambiguity reported rather than forced.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define every physical slot including empty slots, expected DIMM identity and allowed trained speed/voltage; redacted summaries cannot replace exact restricted evidence.
expected_evidence: No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Type 17 memory-device metadata and reboot persistence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, normalization/tolerance policies, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents a single truncated DIMM record or unprotected identifier dump from passing a complete per-slot topology and trained-state test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 17 combines immutable inventory, capability and negotiated operating values. Empty slots and extended fields use sentinels, so per-slot mapping and field-specific comparison rules are essential. The reboot can alter training state and requires approval, making REQUIRES correct.
